summary: Define the local Docker lab contract
description: Define topology, external runtime-root containment, image-lock policy, readiness and hardening schemas, threat boundaries, scenario vocabulary, public-safety rules, and reset invariants before Docker implementation.
acceptance: Runtime paths are outside Git and reject checkout, /mnt, traversal, and symlink escape.
Lab manifest, image lock, readiness, and security matrix use strict Draft 2020-12 schemas with positive and negative fixtures.
The network contract requires an internal bridge with isolated gateway mode and forbids published host ports, second application networks, privileged mode, and Docker socket mounts.
The YAML desired-state example is replaced by schema-valid JSON using synthetic secret_ref values.
Public-safety checks reject generated service state, secrets, private network identifiers, host paths, and unredacted Docker evidence.
Reset requires a valid direct-child lab ID, trusted marker, matching Compose project, and bounded labelled resources.
